outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative micrographs/reconstructions (2D projection, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) for CtpG-mEos; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows representative micrographs/reconstructions for PacL2-mEos, analogous to panel A; not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of proportion of clustered molecules per cell showing mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows representative sptPALM micrographs (localizations, trajectories, mobile/immobile overlay); not a plot of averaged data.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (a distribution, not a mean/average bar plot) and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement over time; both plot types are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph with example single-molecule trajectories; these are visual/microscopy-derived representations, not summary plots of averaged data.
